topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: I don't care how curious they are; it’s just a box in the ground, wrapped in the past. They dig it up, fingers dusted with old earth, like they've solved some grand mystery. It wasn't even their doing, a memory they can't claim, yet they act as if they’ve unearthed a treasure. I watch as they sift through the contents, a cheap thrill of revelation. They’re not thinking about the hands that once placed those items, the hopes or the forgetfulness. It’s all just a spectacle now, a moment’s amusement. I could tell them it’s a waste of time, but what’s the point? They won’t listen, too caught up in their little discovery.
